card.name: Prepositions in idioms like in check
card.fires_on: Short prepositions (in, into, at, to) that follow a verb and its object and begin an idiom, such as keep X in check, keep X at bay, put into effect, or in mind.

modes.label: Keep X in/at ...
modes.description: Preposition after 'keep' plus an object, starting a fixed phrase like in check or at bay.
modes.example: help keep infection and diseases<< at>> bay.

modes.label: Other idiomatic motion or state
modes.description: Preposition after a verb in set phrases like kicks into high gear or put into effect.
modes.example: the 2012 campaign season kicks<< into>> high gear.

card.writes: It favors completions like 'action' and 'bay', which fit idioms such as 'in action' or 'at bay'.
card.plain: It fires on small words like in, at and into that start a set phrase, such as 'keep the disease in check'.
